properties.displayName: Audit Event ASIM parser for AWS CloudTrail EC2 LaunchAndAccess activity
properties.query:
let parser = (disabled: bool = false, pack: bool = false) {
  let Events = datatable(EventName: string, EventType: string, Object: string)
  [
    "AssociateEnclaveCertificateIamRole", "Set", "AWS Certificate Manager Certificate",
    "CreateDelegateMacVolumeOwnershipTask", "Create", "Mac Modification Task",
    "CreateInstanceConnectEndpoint", "Create", "EC2 Instance Connect Endpoint",
    "CreateKeyPair", "Create", "Key Pair",
    "CreateLaunchTemplate", "Create", "Launch Template",
    "CreateLaunchTemplateVersion", "Create", "Launch Template Version",
    "CreateMacSystemIntegrityProtectionModificationTask", "Create", "Mac Modification Task",
    "CreatePlacementGroup", "Create", "Placement Group",
    "DeleteInstanceConnectEndpoint", "Delete", "EC2 Instance Connect Endpoint",
    "DeleteKeyPair", "Delete", "Key Pair",
    "DeleteLaunchTemplate", "Delete", "Launch Template",
    "DeleteLaunchTemplateVersions", "Delete", "Launch Template",
    "DeletePlacementGroup", "Delete", "Placement Group",
    "DescribeInstanceConnectEndpoints", "Read", "Instance Connect Endpoint",
    "DescribeKeyPairs", "Read", "Key Pair",
    "DescribeLaunchTemplates", "Read", "Launch Template",
    "DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions", "Read", "Launch Template",
    "DescribeMacModificationTasks", "Read", "Mac Modification Task",
    "DescribePlacementGroups", "Read", "Placement Group",
    "DisableSerialConsoleAccess", "Disable", "EC2 Serial Console",
    "DisassociateEnclaveCertificateIamRole", "Delete", "IAM Role",
    "EnableSerialConsoleAccess", "Enable", "EC2 Serial Console",
    "GetAssociatedEnclaveCertificateIamRoles", "Read", "IAM Role",
    "GetConsoleOutput", "Read", "EC2 Instance",
    "GetConsoleScreenshot", "Read", "EC2 Instance",
    "GetInstanceTpmEkPub", "Read", "EC2 Instance",
    "GetLaunchTemplateData", "Read", "EC2 Instance",
    "GetPasswordData", "Read", "EC2 Instance",
    "GetSerialConsoleAccessStatus", "Read", "EC2 Serial Console",
    "ImportKeyPair", "Create", "Key Pair",
    "ModifyInstanceConnectEndpoint", "Set", "Instance Connect Endpoint",
    "ModifyLaunchTemplate", "Set", "Launch Template"
  ];
  AWSCloudTrail
  | where not(disabled)
  | where EventSource == "ec2.amazonaws.com"
  | where EventName in (Events | project EventName)
  | lookup kind=inner Events on EventName
  | extend RequestParameters = todynamic(RequestParameters), ResponseElements = todynamic(ResponseElements)
  | extend EventResult = iff(isempty(ErrorCode) and isempty(ErrorMessage), "Success", "Failure")
  | extend NewValue = iff(EventResult == "Success", case(
      EventName == "AssociateEnclaveCertificateIamRole", RequestParameters.RoleArn,
      EventName in ("CreateDelegateMacVolumeOwnershipTask",
        "CreateMacSystemIntegrityProtectionModificationTask"), ResponseElements.macModificationTask,
      EventName == "CreateInstanceConnectEndpoint", ResponseElements.instanceConnectEndpoint,
      EventName == "CreateLaunchTemplate", ResponseElements.launchTemplate,
      EventName == "CreateLaunchTemplateVersion", ResponseElements.launchTemplateVersion,
      EventName == "CreatePlacementGroup", ResponseElements.placementGroup,
      EventName == "EnableSerialConsoleAccess", ResponseElements.serialConsoleAccessEnabled,
      EventName == "ImportKeyPair", ResponseElements,
      EventName == "ModifyInstanceConnectEndpoint", RequestParameters.PreserveClientIp,
      EventName == "ModifyLaunchTemplate", RequestParameters.LaunchTemplateName,
      ""
    ), "")
  | extend ObjectId = case(
      EventName == "AssociateEnclaveCertificateIamRole", RequestParameters.CertificateArn,
      EventName in ("CreateDelegateMacVolumeOwnershipTask",
        "CreateMacSystemIntegrityProtectionModificationTask"),
        ResponseElements.macModificationTask.macModificationTaskId,
      EventName == "CreateInstanceConnectEndpoint",
        ResponseElements.instanceConnectEndpoint.instanceConnectEndpointId,
      EventName in ("CreateKeyPair", "DeleteKeyPair", "ImportKeyPair"), ResponseElements.keyPairId,
      EventName == "CreateLaunchTemplate", ResponseElements.launchTemplate.launchTemplateId,
      EventName == "CreateLaunchTemplateVersion", ResponseElements.launchTemplateVersion.imageId,
      EventName == "CreatePlacementGroup", ResponseElements.placementGroup.placementGroupId,
      EventName in ("DeleteInstanceConnectEndpoint", "ModifyInstanceConnectEndpoint"),
        RequestParameters.InstanceConnectEndpointId,
      EventName in ("DeleteLaunchTemplate", "DeleteLaunchTemplateVersions", "DescribeLaunchTemplates",
        "DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions", "ModifyLaunchTemplate"), RequestParameters.LaunchTemplateId,
      EventName == "DeletePlacementGroup", RequestParameters.GroupName,
      EventName == "DescribeInstanceConnectEndpoints", RequestParameters.InstanceConnectEndpointId.N,
      EventName == "DescribeKeyPairs", RequestParameters.KeyPairId,
      EventName == "DescribeMacModificationTasks", RequestParameters.MacModificationTaskId,
      EventName == "DescribePlacementGroups", RequestParameters.GroupId,
      EventName == "DisassociateEnclaveCertificateIamRole", RequestParameters.RoleArn,
      EventName in ("GetConsoleOutput", "GetConsoleScreenshot", "GetPasswordData"), ResponseElements.instanceId,
      EventName in ("GetInstanceTpmEkPub", "GetLaunchTemplateData"), RequestParameters.InstanceId,
      ""
    )
  | extend
      Type = "AWSCloudTrail",
      EventCount = int(1),
      EventStartTime = TimeGenerated,
      EventEndTime = TimeGenerated,
      EventSeverity = "Informational",
      EventSchema = "AuditEvent",
      EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
      EventVendor = "AWS",
      EventProduct = "CloudTrail",
      Dvc = "CloudTrail",
      EventMessage = ErrorMessage,
      ObjectType = "Cloud Resource",
      TargetAppName = "Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud",
      TargetAppType = "Service"
  | project-rename
      EventOriginalSubType = EventTypeName,
      EventOriginalType = EventName,
      EventUid = AwsEventId,
      EventOriginalResultDetails = ErrorMessage,
      EventProductVersion = EventVersion,
      ActorUserId = UserIdentityAccountId,
      ActorUsername = UserIdentityUserName,
      ActorOriginalUserType = UserIdentityType,
      HttpUserAgent = UserAgent
  | extend
      ActorUserIdType = iff(isempty(ActorUserId), "", "AWSId"),
      ActorUsernameType = iff(isempty(ActorUsername), "", "Simple"),
      SrcIpAddr = iff(ipv4_is_in_range(SourceIpAddress, "0.0.0.0/0"), SourceIpAddress, ""),
      ActingApplicationEntityKey = "",
      ActorUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
      ActorUserEntityKey = "",
      AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]),
      DvcEntityKey = "",
      SrcSystemEntityKey = "",
      TargetApplicationEntityKey = "",
      TargetSystemEntityKey = ""
  | extend AdditionalFields = iff(pack, bag_pack(
      "ActorAccessKeyId", UserIdentityAccessKeyId,
      "AWSRegion", AWSRegion,
      "APIVersion", APIVersion,
      "ManagementEvent", ManagementEvent,
      "ReadOnly", ReadOnly,
      "RequestParameters", RequestParameters,
      "ResponseElements", ResponseElements
    ), dynamic({}))
  | extend
      Operation = EventOriginalType,
      User = ActorUsername,
      IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
      Application = TargetAppName,
      Value = NewValue
  | project
      TimeGenerated, Type, EventCount, EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventSeverity,
      EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion, EventVendor, EventProduct, Dvc, EventResult,
      EventMessage, TargetAppName, EventOriginalSubType, EventOriginalType, EventUid,
      EventOriginalResultDetails, EventProductVersion, ActorUserId, ActorUsername,
      ActorOriginalUserType, HttpUserAgent, ActorUserIdType, ActorUsernameType,
      SrcIpAddr, AdditionalFields, User, IpAddr, Application, EventType, NewValue,
      Value, ObjectId, ObjectType, Object, TargetAppType, Operation,
      ActingApplicationEntityKey, ActorUserAdditionalIds, ActorUserEntityKey,
      AdditionalEntities, DvcEntityKey, SrcSystemEntityKey,
      TargetApplicationEntityKey, TargetSystemEntityKey
};
parser(disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
